requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Render the review card unconditionally for any authenticated student even when the authoritative summary reports no pending review.

positive_control.evidence: Pending summary in real Chromium renders the review card and actionable notification on /inicio. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

sibling_cases.observed: Existing component test keeps the no-pending state without CTA.
Student home remains behind the authenticated application route and uses student/me APIs.

regression_controls.evidence: Existing Home.behavior regression keeps ACTIVE_STUDENT on the student home rather than lead/professor flows. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Expose a visible CTA that points to a public or nonexistent route, or drops the authenticated student context during navigation.

positive_control.evidence: Mobile Chromium focuses the CTA and Enter reaches /student/profile-review with the selected contractId preserved. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

sibling_cases.observed: Destination is the authenticated /student/profile-review route declared in App routing.
Keyboard navigation preserves contractId in the destination URL and scoped API header.

regression_controls.evidence: StudentProfileReview route test preserves the vínculo when returning to /inicio. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Make review notifications clickable only through a mobile deepLink, or show notifications from another review/contract in the current student context.

positive_control.evidence: Real Chromium shows the relevant long review notification as a web link and hides the unrelated review notification. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

sibling_cases.observed: Notification carrying another reviewId/alunoId is absent from the rendered student home.
Relevant notification uses the same web review destination and does not require a mobile deepLink.

regression_controls.evidence: Existing StudentProfileReviewEntry tests cover requested/reminder/overdue filtering and navigation behavior. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat empty or transient API states as a fatal screen, show a false CTA, or make retry ineffective after a recoverable failure.

positive_control.evidence: Real Chromium injected a summary 500, rendered the recoverable error, accepted keyboard retry, and returned to the pending state. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

sibling_cases.observed: Existing component test renders no pending review without false CTA.
Chromium retry issues exactly one fresh summary request and recovers.

regression_controls.evidence: Behavior tests cover pending, empty and error states without changing professor/lead routing. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Navigate correctly in the happy path but omit x-contract-id on one of the student/me requests, allowing ambiguous multi-contract context.

positive_control.evidence: The Chromium harness asserts every student/me request carries x-contract-id=contract-342-evidence. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

sibling_cases.observed: GET /student/me/summary is observed with the selected x-contract-id.
GET /notifications and /profile-review are both observed with the same selected x-contract-id.

regression_controls.evidence: student-self.service tests preserve x-contract-id propagation and route query context. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Declare the layout responsive from Tailwind/JSX inspection while the rendered browser actually clips the CTA or overflows with long content on a supported viewport.

positive_control.evidence: Dedicated exact-head Chromium run completed successfully with screenshots at 1366x768 and 390x844 and zero horizontal overflow. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

sibling_cases.observed: Desktop document/body scroll width equals 1366 and primary content/CTA remain visible.
Mobile document/body scroll width equals 390 while long notification text wraps and the CTA remains within the viewport.
Keyboard CTA navigation and recoverable-error retry both execute successfully at 390x844.

regression_controls.evidence: The workflow builds the web candidate before launching Chromium, preventing screenshots from a stale/unbuilt source tree. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Add the new student entry point by bypassing existing authenticated routing or by broadening student data beyond the selected vínculo.

positive_control.evidence: The implementation reuses the existing authenticated home and student/me service; browser evidence remains contract-scoped. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

sibling_cases.observed: No new public review route or unauthenticated data adapter is introduced.
All student/me requests in browser evidence carry the chosen contract header and unrelated notification data is filtered.

regression_controls.evidence: No backend authorization, schema, migration, or security rule was changed by the remediation delta. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Create a parallel endpoint/home just to satisfy the new UI, or validate a stale path that is not the one used at final navigation time.

positive_control.evidence: Material source reuses /inicio plus the three existing student/me endpoints, and the exact-head browser run exercises those final paths. evidence/a342003-remediation.json

sibling_cases.observed: The exercised entry route is /inicio, not a parallel home.
Only /student/me/summary, /student/me/notifications and /student/me/profile-review are consumed for the feature.

regression_controls.evidence: The remediation adds only a browser evidence harness/workflow; no production endpoint, schema or alternate navigation surface was added. evidence/a342003-remediation.json
